text: Review satisfied; closing. Coded is a sealed trait over Known/Unmapped/Absent/NotApplicable/Undetermined as final non-case classes with private[corpus] constructors -- deliberately NOT an enum, since Scala 3 enum cases are case classes and that was the hole a third review found by probe. Applicability ships here as required, with WhenColumnEquals/WhenColumnIn and a tri-state evaluate. All three probes exist out of package in storymodel4s.consumer.CorpusCarrierProbeSuite and are green: 'a consumer cannot fabricate a decode status', 'cannot reach a decode status through Mirror or copy' (the Mirror route is the one that makes a bare private insufficient), 'cannot mint a code book, a row context, or run the decoder' -- each paired with a positive control in the same scope, per docs/design/unforgeable-types.md. Cold review of the whole subsystem returned 2026-09-17 and raised nothing against Coded; it found the identity collision at the OTHER site the P8 bead named.
